Finding 1 of 2

Chamber MR04B carries vt loss

Priority1ReasonAssociational candidatevt
Decision routeProblem → Reason → Timing → What to do now → Check it with the data
  1. 1
    Problem

    vt is worse for the 159 of 442 wafers processed through chamber MR04B than for wafers processed elsewhere.

  2. 2
    Reason

    When paired with a wafer from outside chamber MR04B, the chamber MR04B wafer has worse vt about 71% of the time, a gap matched only 17 times across 400 random draws (p=0.0450). This confirms a distinct performance difference, but it stops short of proving a physical cause because other shared processing factors traveled with these wafers.

  3. 3
    Timing

    These wafers ran between 2025-12-30 and 2026-02-21. The first-run screen does not indicate whether this shift continues in current production.

    Read from entity timestamps over the complete observed horizon.

  4. 4
    What to do now

    Run chamber MR04B against chamber MR04A on matched runs by scheduling the same device types across both within one month, then read vt on the product. This is an association, not a cause. Do not requalify chamber MR04B or take it out of service on this evidence alone.

  5. 5
    Check it with the data
    F4Did the supplied intervention end the registered loss?Attach the supplied intervention labels to frozen run scores and test the registered direction.

Finding 2 of 2

Lot 3955770 carries bin24 loss

Priority2ReasonAssociational candidatebin24
Decision routeProblem → Reason → Timing → What to do now → Check it with the data
  1. 1
    Problem

    bin24 is worse for the 24 of 442 wafers in lot 3955770 than for wafers in any other lot.

  2. 2
    Reason

    A wafer from lot 3955770 has worse bin24 than an outside wafer about 97% of the time. The evidence isolates the issue to this specific lot, but it stops there and cannot prove a physical mechanism because all wafers in the lot moved through production together.

  3. 3
    Timing

    These wafers ran between 2026-03-21 and 2026-03-25. The initial screen does not state whether this condition is ongoing.

    Read from entity timestamps over the complete observed horizon.

  4. 4
    What to do now

    Pull the physical tracking records for lot 3955770 and compare them against same-device lots produced during the same processing window. This is an association, not a cause. The run can say the loss sits on these lots and cannot say what differed inside them.

Screened, not confirmed

What the correction held back

These cohorts were ranked by the same search as the findings above and either did not clear the family-wise correction across every level screened or sit where no correction can price them. They are not findings, no follow-up is offered for them, and they are recorded here so the standard this report holds itself to is visible rather than implied.

  • Chamber MR05A carries bin20 and bin24 loss11 of 111 runs (52 of 442 wafers) went through chamber MR05A, and bin20 and bin24 are worse there than elsewhere. Reshuffling the chamber labels across 400 draws reproduced a gap that large 145 times (p=0.3650) once the strongest of the 8 chambers screened was corrected for, so this is screened, not confirmed.
  • Chamber MR02C carries idss and igss loss10 of 111 runs (41 of 442 wafers) went through chamber MR02C, and idss and igss are worse there than elsewhere. Reshuffling the chamber labels across 400 draws reproduced a gap that large 272 times (p=0.6825) once the strongest of the 8 chambers screened was corrected for, so this is screened, not confirmed.
  • Lot group carries bin20 loss14 of 111 runs (40 of 442 wafers) went through lots 3636800, 3714006 and 3687472, and bin20 is worse there than elsewhere. Each of these lots is one whole lot, and no draw that keeps a lot together can price a group of them. It marks where the loss sits; it cannot say what put it there.
  • Chamber MR01B carries bin24 loss3 of 111 runs (5 of 442 wafers) went through chamber MR01B, and bin24 is worse there than elsewhere. Every one of them came from a single lot, so nothing that separates this chamber from the rest can be separated from that lot either. It marks where the loss sits; it cannot say what put it there.

TDA

Named response phenotypes

Density regions are named from their outcome profiles. The same names appear on every finding that lands in them and are preserved in the link manifest, so the application can highlight a region directly from report text.

Wafers that fail alike sit together: a wafer's neighbours predict its failure type (R² 0.72).

Reason

What the current evidence points to

Target-blind process screens identify candidate operating conditions, while equipment spread helps distinguish a localized concentration from a broader scheduling pattern. Both remain observational until the registered follow-ups test them.

Between lots

Within lots

Candidate operating limits · not yet validated

Each row is the strongest split of one screened condition, scored on the same runs that selected it. The precision and false-alarm counts size the trade-off; they are optimistic by construction, which is exactly what the threshold follow-up re-scores on held-out units. Every row is a column something in the dataset establishes as a setting: a rule on anything else is not a candidate limit and is not printed as one. Two classes of column can never appear here, and of the 8 conditions this run screened, 0 are in the first and 0 in the second. An in-process measurement does come before the outcome — the timing objection does not apply to it — and is still not a setting anyone makes: an in-situ trace or a return temperature is a reading, and there is no dial behind it to hold to a line. A co-measured detector is a column nothing establishes as recorded before the outcome at all. Either can be an early-warning signal and never an operating limit. The first call is read off the column naming and off setpoint-and-reading pairs in the inventory rather than off any measurement, so where it is wrong the fix is in the column inventory: declare the column a process role and it returns to this table.

Chamber scoreboard

Every chamber carrying at least three independent runs is scored against every registered outcome, after removing additive device and calendar-month levels. 1 of 8 carry a level effect that survives a permutation null corrected across the whole column; MR01B leads. This is where the cohort ran, not a statement about equipment health.

When the loss appears

Per-device response trends

The registered devices do not move together, so a single horizon-wide statement about the outcome would average away the part that is still getting worse. Direction is a rank correlation with time inside each device; it describes the observed horizon, not present-day state.

TDA drift by device

Each path is one device's monthly centroid on the same frozen landscape, joined in calendar order. A path that crosses into a degraded region is a change in which phenotype that family occupies. Connections show order, not continuous motion, and distance between distant points is not meaningful.

Follow-up analyses

F1–F4: tests that can change the decision

These identifiers and questions are the same ones used by the generated review reports.

F1

Is this still happening in the most recent runs?

Retest Lot 3955770 carries bin24 loss in the latest independent runs.

temporal_persistence · finding-2
F2

What operating limit should be tested, and what would it cost in false alarms?

Repeat the complete process-condition search and score candidate rules on held-out runs.

threshold_rule · finding-2
F3

Which process conditions actually carry the outcome out of sample, and in what order?

Fit the outcome on the route features across held-out runs and rank each feature by the held-out accuracy lost when it is permuted.

driver_attribution · finding-2
F4

Did the supplied intervention end the registered loss?

Attach the supplied intervention labels to frozen run scores and test the registered direction.

matched_validation · finding-1

Retrospective thresholds remain candidates only. Any operational limit must pass prospective shadow validation before enforcement.

What to carry forward

Conclusion and limits

The report ranks bounded findings and exposes only follow-ups that can change their status.

  • All registered findings are observational.
  • Retrospective thresholds require prospective shadow validation.
